title: OpenWorkResponse
description: P2C-OPERATIONS-CONSOLE-READ-SLICE (SPEC R2/R7/Amendment 1 R7): exact open-work response contract. The three arrays come from Ledger.open_work_snapshot, mapped from its canonical Task, CustomerRequest and Incident groups. Array item shapes reuse the canonical ../tasks/task.schema.json, ../customers/customer-request.schema.json and ../incidents/incident.schema.json contracts - the status/enum vocabulary is never forked here.
